mapper.sql: c.id, c.customer_no, c.nickname, c.real_name, c.birth_date, c.gender, c.city, c.first_source, c.data_source, c.data_confidence, c.status, c.revision, c.created_at, c.updated_at, a.nick_name AS wechat_nickname, a.head AS wechat_avatar, CASE WHEN a.id IS NULL THEN 'unbound' WHEN a.status=1 THEN 'enabled' ELSE 'disabled' END AS account_status, a.last_login_time, ids.phone_hint, ids.id_card_hint

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, MAX(legacy_app_user_id) AS legacy_app_user_id, MAX(CASE WHEN identifier_type='phone' AND valid_to IS NULL THEN display_hint END) AS phone_hint, MAX(CASE WHEN identifier_type='id_card' AND valid_to IS NULL THEN display_hint END) AS id_card_hint FROM ql_customer_identifier GROUP BY customer_id ) ids ON ids.customer_id=c.id LEFT JOIN app_user_info a ON a.id=ids.legacy_app_user_id

SELECT FROM ql_customer c
c.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (c.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%',#{bo.nickname},'%') OR c.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{bo.nickname},'%') OR CONVERT(c.customer_no USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{bo.nickname},'%') OR a.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{bo.nickname},'%'))
AND c.status=#{bo.status}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ql_customer_identifier phone_identifier WHERE phone_identifier.customer_id=c.id AND phone_identifier.identifier_type='phone' AND phone_identifier.valid_to IS NULL AND phone_identifier.normalized_hash=SHA2(#{bo.phone},256) )
AND c.city=#{bo.city}
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC

SELECT FROM ql_customer c
WHERE c.id=#{id} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT eventType, title, detail, occurredAt, source, operatorName, sessionId, sessionNumber, sessionName, registrationId, referenceId FROM ( SELECT 'profile_created' AS eventType, '建立轻友档案' AS title, CONCAT('轻友编号：', CONVERT(c.customer_no USING utf8mb4)) AS detail, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS occurredAt, c.data_source AS source, NULL AS operatorName, NULL AS sessionId, NULL AS sessionNumber, NULL AS sessionName, NULL AS registrationId, c.id AS referenceId, 10 AS sortOrder FROM ql_customer c WHERE c.id=#{id} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'registration_submitted', '提交报名', CONCAT('报名状态：', CONVERT(r.registration_status USING utf8mb4), '；付款状态：', CONVERT(r.payment_status USING utf8mb4)), DATE_FORMAT(r.registered_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), r.registration_source, NULL, s.id, s.session_number, s.name, r.id, r.batch_id, 20 FROM ql_registration r JOIN ql_session s ON s.id=r.session_id WHERE r.customer_id=#{id}
UNION ALL
SELECT 'registration_status', CASE WHEN l.to_status='confirmed' THEN '报名确认' ELSE '报名状态变更' END, CONCAT(COALESCE(CONVERT(l.from_status USING utf8mb4), '未设置'), ' → ', CONVERT(l.to_status USING utf8mb4), CASE WHEN l.change_reason IS NULL OR l.change_reason='' THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('；', CONVERT(l.change_reason USING utf8mb4)) END), DATE_FORMAT(l.changed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'operator_entry', u.nick_name, s.id, s.session_number, s.name, r.id, l.id, 30 FROM ql_registration_status_log l JOIN ql_registration r ON r.id=l.registration_id JOIN ql_session s ON s.id=r.session_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=l.operator_id WHERE r.customer_id=#{id} AND l.status_type='registration' AND NOT (l.from_status IS NULL AND l.to_status='pending')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'payment_confirmed', '付款确认', CONCAT('金额 ¥', FORMAT(t.amount, 2), '；方式：', CONVERT(t.payment_method USING utf8mb4), '；状态：', CONVERT(t.status USING utf8mb4), CASE WHEN t.remark IS NULL OR t.remark='' THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('；', CONVERT(t.remark USING utf8mb4)) END), DATE_FORMAT(t.transaction_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), t.record_source, u.nick_name, s.id, s.session_number, s.name, t.registration_id, t.id, 40 FROM ql_transaction t LEFT JOIN ql_session s ON s.id=t.session_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=t.operator_id WHERE t.customer_id=#{id}
UNION ALL
SELECT 'attendance', '到场登记', CONCAT('第', d.day_no, '天（', DATE_FORMAT(d.activity_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), '）：', CONVERT(p.attendance_status USING utf8mb4)), DATE_FORMAT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.corrected_source,p.check_in_source)='mobile_workspace' THEN CONVERT_TZ(COALESCE(p.checked_in_at,p.updated_at), '+00:00', '+08:00') ELSE COALESCE(p.checked_in_at,p.updated_at) END, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), COALESCE(o.corrected_source,p.check_in_source, 'system'), u.nick_name, s.id, s.session_number, s.name, p.registration_id, p.id, 50 FROM ql_participation_day p LEFT JOIN ql_attendance_origin_correction o ON o.participation_day_id=p.id AND o.original_checked_in_at=p.checked_in_at AND o.original_operator_id=p.checked_in_by AND o.original_source=p.check_in_source JOIN ql_session_day d ON d.id=p.session_day_id JOIN ql_session s ON s.id=d.session_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=p.checked_in_by WHERE p.customer_id=#{id} AND p.attendance_status!='not_arrived'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'session_completed', '活动完成', '期次状态：已完成', DATE_FORMAT(s.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'system', u.nick_name, s.id, s.session_number, s.name, r.id, s.id, 60 FROM ql_registration r JOIN ql_session s ON s.id=r.session_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.updated_by WHERE r.customer_id=#{id} AND s.status='completed'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'staff_interview', '工作人员回访', i.content, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(i.created_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'mobile_workspace', i.operator_name, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, i.id, 70 FROM ql_staff_interview i WHERE i.customer_id=#{id} ) timeline ORDER BY occurredAt DESC, sortOrder DESC
